core.title: 18 Inch Patio Door Flush Bolt, Global FB4
tags: door bolts for store front doors

text.description_html:
18" Patio Door Extension Flush Bolt

These 18" extension flush door bolts are for impact patio doors. Template Size 16" - Rod 16" with 1/8" offset. Available Aluminum or Duro (Dark Bronze) finish colors. Comes complete with flush bolt assembly, extension rod and guide plate.

Flush bolts (also know as door edge bolts) are installed into the edge of the door and have a toggle lever that is moved up and down to push the attached rod and bolt into a header or threshold (footer), which locks or unlocks an inactive door.

Specifications: for Global FB4 Flush Bolt

  • Flush Bolt Length: 18"
  • Rod Length: 16" (1/4"-20 thread rod)
  • Offset: 1/8"
  • Spring loaded lever action
  • Supplied with nylon keeper (guide plate) and fasteners
  • Square nylon tip with Beveled Corners Fits in 1/2" (13 mm) Square or Round Strike
  • Bolt Throw: 7/8"
  • Backset: 7/8"
  • 5/8" adjustment on rod length
  • Face Plate: 15/16" Wide x 4-1/4" High with 5/32" radius corner
  • Mounting Holes: 5-7/32" Center to Center

*Sold Individually.
